question: How many combined points will be scored in the Detroit Lions at Buffalo Bills game on September 17, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: NFL regular-season games with closing totals of ~51-54. The closing/consensus total for this game is 52.5 (Bills -3), the highest on the Week 2 slate; sportsbook totals are near-unbiased predictors (mean error +0.7, median error 0) with residual SD ~13.4 pts, so the market number is the right center and dispersion dominates everything else. I set the median at 51 rather than 52.5 because the combined-points distribution is right-skewed (mean > median) and high-total games run slightly under the line. Case specifics move nothing: both QBs (Allen, Goff) healthy through preseason, two elite offenses, mid-September Buffalo weather is a non-factor at the new open-air-but-canopied Highmark Stadium, and Week 1 has not yet been played so injury news is symmetric two-sided risk already inside the SD. No Polymarket, Manifold, or retrievable Kalshi contract found; the sportsbook total is a clean contract match (official final score, OT included) and is my anchor. Open bounds priced by mechanism: ~1.2% below 19.5 (turnover-fest/defensive slugfest, e.g. 13-6 — rare given two top offenses) and ~3% above 80.5 (full shootout, e.g. 45-38 — league-wide ~2% of games, concentrated in exactly this kind of matchup).
